messages:
maya: thinking about a safer default for model-version rollouts. current step-schedule is okay but ops wants less churning and clearer rollback triggers. proposing a 'micro-ramp + floor + holdpoint' pattern. thoughts?

sam: sounds good. can you sketch how it looks in config? especially how the floor interacts with reserved capacity & quotas.

maya: sure, rough draft below. key ideas: 1) start with tiny cohort (0.1%), 2) micro-ramps (x2 every 5m) until floor (e.g., 5%), 3) plateau windows with telemetry gate checks, 4) automatic rollback if error-rate or latency delta exceed thresholds.

eli: micro-ramps + plateau seems reasonable. worried about noise if telemetry sampling is low. need deterministic checks tied to request counts not just time.

faizal: agree with eli. we should use absolute request windows: e.g., evaluate after 10k requests or 10 minutes whichever comes first. also include minimum signal of unique users to avoid single-user flaps.

annika: UX note: console should show next scheduled step + confidence (telemetry pass/fail). users keep asking "what happens if quota is hit mid-ramp?" We should document fallback behavior.

maya: good call. proposal below (quick config snippet). takes percent_ramp, ramp_interval, floor_percent, eval_window_requests, metrics thresholds.

maya: ```json
{
  "rollout_type": "micro_ramp_with_hold",
  "start_percent": 0.1,
  "ramp_factor": 2,
  "ramp_interval_seconds": 300,
  "floor_percent": 5,
  "max_percent": 100,
  "eval": {
    "min_requests": 10000,
    "min_unique_users": 50,
    "window_seconds": 900,
    "thresholds": {
      "p95_latency_ms_delta": 100,
      "error_rate_delta_pct": 0.5
    }
  },
  "on_quota_exhaust": "pause_and_notify",
  "on_eval_fail": "rollback_one_step",
  "on_eval_pass": "continue",
  "safety_guards": ["concurrent_cohort_limit", "region_capacity_check"]
}
```

sam: a couple comments: - on_quota_exhaust should optionally fallback to cheaper model variant, not just pause. - rollback_one_step might oscillate; consider cooldown/backoff.

eli: prefer "rollback_to_previous_stable" rather than one-step if we detect regression. and add a hard SLO cutoff that triggers immediate rollback to 0% if severe.

faizal: telemetry hooks we need: incremental sampling for tracing during micro-ramps, and a special tag to correlate cohort requests. that way we can compute cohort-specific p99/p95. also prefer relative deltas with minimum absolute floor to avoid tiny-signal noise.

annika: UX: console timeline should show predicted ramp vs actual plus a simple reason code when paused (quota / eval_fail / manual). show a one-click rollback and a preview of impact (estimated requests affected).

maya: updated behavior: - on_quota_exhaust: if cheaper_variant available -> route to cheaper_variant and continue ramp, otherwise pause + notify. - rollback logic: immediate rollback-to-last-stable if delta > hard_cutoff, else step-back + cooldown.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary for model v12 -> v13 using config id cfg_2026_03_20_01. initial cohort 0.1% at 2478901111.

sam: FYI: if we route to cheaper_variant on quota, we must ensure the cheaper model is ABI-compatible (same API/response schema). otherwise we can leak type errors. add compatibility check to rollout preflight.

eli: agree. preflight should include schema/structural checks + a small deterministic eval run. add to config: "preflight_checks": ["schema_match", "sanity_eval_1k_samples"].

faizal: telemetry alerts for this rollout: - cohort_p95_delta > 100ms for 10m -> warn - cohort_error_rate_delta > 0.5% for 5m -> auto-step-back - hard_cutoff: p95_delta > 250ms OR error_rate_delta > 2% -> immediate rollback to last_stable

annika: can we add a tiny UX affordance: a "snooze auto-rollback" toggle for experimental teams, with explicit risk acknowledgment? must be off by default.

maya: yes, we keep it off by default and gated by a permission flag. action items: 1) eli + sam add preflight checks and cooldown/backoff logic (owner: eli) 2) faizal add cohort-tagging and alerts (owner: faizal) 3) annika prototype console timeline UX + reason codes (owner: annika) 4) maya to update docs and the rollout schema (owner: maya)

sam: small nit: make default eval.min_requests = 5k for low-traffic tenants, but allow tenant override. otherwise ramp could stall forever.

maya: ok, make it configurable per-tenant with a lower bound. final config will include overrides. thanks all.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary paused at 2478901130 due to quota threshold for tenant x-prod. reason: GPU quota hit. notified: #billing, @maya.

maya: received. will follow up with billing + tenant owner and flip to cheaper_variant if safe.

eli: leaving a note to add telemetry event for "canary_paused_reason" so console can present it cleanly.

faizal: will add event and tag it with config id.

maya: good discussion. saving this thread into the rollout RFC draft.
